text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Primary entry assumption: displayed price + 2 cents/share. Dots are scenarios, not confidence intervals.
Each arm: $50 initial cash, $40 reserve, at most $2 per entry / 5 shares. Held until recorded settlement.
Overhead: $200/month prorated over 10.88 days = $72.50 per arm, reported outside trading cash.
Model costs include failed calls and unresolved reservations. Market-implied baseline abstains when no net edge exists.
